column1: # Generated by `lake exe oracle alias` (spec/Oracle.lean) from the definition
# in spec/Aontu: documents with alias declarations, each case its declarations
# and a schema under the key v against a document under the key v, run in the
# default mode, without the fill (noFill) and under --partial (partial), as
# `verdict` rows whose expectation is the one class `vet` gives, which `vet_iff`
# makes the definition's own. A document reads as its expansion; a name declared
# nowhere, or names that break the alias-cycle rule, are an error. A recursive
# name is a residual that expands against the data, as far as it goes.
# Regenerate with `make spec`; never edit by hand. The cases the ports do
# not yet answer this way are listed in spec/ledger.tsv.
# The riders follow in rows r0 on: meta() and deprecate() judging as their
# values, ident() on an alias's value, and ident() anywhere else, an error.
